Author: Kuldeep Mathur
Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 15728/2022 Om Prakash S/o Jodha Ram, Aged About 31 Years, R/o Nagar Tehsil Gudamalani P.S. RGT, District Barmer.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(At present lodged in Central Jail, Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Manish Shishodia, Sr. Advocate  assisted by Mr. R.J. Punia

For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.S. Rajpurohit, P.P.
 Mr. Pritam Solanki, for the  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/01/2023 The application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.204/2022, registered at Police Station Kotwali,
District Sirohi for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 304B IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner so also the learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant and perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner drew attention of this Court towards statement of Paburam,
father of deceased Nirmala under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and submitted that from perusal of the same it is apparent that a case could not have been registered against the petitioner under Section 304B IPC.

Learned counsel further submitted that looking to the facts of the case, the (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-15728/2022] petitioner cannot be attributed with death of the deceased Nirmala,
therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused petitioner.
On the contrary, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application of the accused-petitioner.

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the bail application is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Om Prakash S/o Jodha Ram arrested in connection with FIR No.204/2022, registered at Police Station Kotwali,
District Sirohi shall be enlarged on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so, till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 80-Ravi Kh/-
